entity.name: Dhruva Sagar
entity.description: Author and sole maintainer of Lattice, building it in evenings and weekends alongside a full-time job and funding it myself so far. Long-time vim user and plugin author; Lattice is the editor I want to exist: vim's grammar, emacs's extensibility, and a modern, non-blocking core.

projects.name: Lattice
projects.description: A modal, GPU-accelerated, plugin-first text editor written in Rust. It combines vim's modal editing grammar with emacs's extensibility model on a non-blocking, multi-threaded core, so nothing a plugin or language server does can stall typing. Plugins are WebAssembly components written against an open WIT interface, so they can be written in any language with component-model support, and they run capability-gated, fuel-limited and crash-isolated. It runs in the terminal and as a native GPU window, and ships an org-mode plugin, a git client modelled on magit, LSP support and an in-editor help system. MIT licensed.
